name: Ghost replay of a move
visual_intent: A bounce, arc or throw leaves a short-lived trail of ghosts.

parameters.name: motion
parameters.description: function (tl, el, at) { return Studio.space.bounce(tl, el, at); } - fromTo tweens only

parameters.name: lag
parameters.description: Seconds between ghosts (2 frames at 30 fps)

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: While the move is the subject of the narration or caption

code_snippet.javascript: Studio.space.trail(tl, '#ball', 1.0, function (t, el, at) { return Studio.space.bounce(t, el, at, { height: 30 }); }, { count: 4, lag: 0.05 });

fallbacks: A dashed motion path (marching-dashed-stroke) drawn behind the object.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
